listening.title: Running a product demo for a client team

lines.speaker: Linh (Product Owner)
lines.text: Good morning, everyone. Today I will walk you through our new reporting tool.

lines.speaker: Nam (Solution Engineer)
lines.text: Before we start, can you tell us your biggest pain point today?

lines.speaker: Linh (Product Owner)
lines.text: Their team exports numbers by hand every Friday afternoon.

lines.speaker: Nam (Solution Engineer)
lines.text: Then this use case is perfect. Let me share my screen now.

lines.speaker: Linh (Product Owner)
lines.text: Please remember that everything you see here is dummy data.

lines.speaker: Nam (Solution Engineer)
lines.text: The key feature is here. One click builds the whole weekly report.

lines.speaker: Linh (Product Owner)
lines.text: And it looks the same on a phone, so the experience is seamless.

lines.speaker: Nam (Solution Engineer)
lines.text: That is our value proposition: your team saves about four hours a week.

lines.speaker: Linh (Product Owner)
lines.text: Can people try it themselves before they decide?

lines.speaker: Nam (Solution Engineer)
lines.text: Of course. I will send a sandbox account to each user this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Linh (Product Owner)
lines.text: Great. Shall we keep the last ten minutes for questions?

lines.speaker: Nam (Solution Engineer)
lines.text: Yes, please. I would rather answer questions than show more slides.
